data.body:
STATUS: waiting on infrastructure, not on the change.

Gerrit 1704 is up with patch set 1. CI run https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/31671006152 has passed everything that has been scheduled — clear Verified, artifact provenance, optionality (both legs), eval discipline, require-resolvable-rebar-ticket, verify-identity, golden-path — and the remaining jobs (the pytest matrix across ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 + macos 3.13, lint+type-check, pip-audit, mutation shards) have been sitting QUEUED on runner availability for over an hour. No job has failed. LLM-Review has not voted yet either.

The local host is in the same shape for an unrelated reason: load average 18-30 from Spotlight indexing and other sessions, which is why the local CI-parity pytest run crawls (32% in one attempt, 17% in a second). That is environmental; the targeted suites covering every line this change touches all pass quickly (29 + 14 + 41).

Ticket stays in_progress. Per the AGENTS.md rule I will not close it before Verified +1 — a passing completion verifier is not a substitute for green CI — and I will not submit before both LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
